projects.title: Elliptic Curve Cryptography: An Application of Geometry and Number Theory in Information Security
projects.description:
Abstract. Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) is a private key cryptosystem which has
become popular in recent years because of its numerous advantages. ECC, as the name
suggests, is based on the mathematical concepts of elliptic curves. Elliptic curves are a
successful approach to securing information since solving the elliptic curve discrete logarithm
problem has proven to be quite difficult. Given the importance and popularity of
Elliptic Curve Cryptography in Information Security, this research will show that geometry
and number theory make this cryptosystem highly secure.

projects.title: A Theoretical Approach to Ensuring Instructional and Curriculum Coherence of STEM Writing Intensive (STEM-WIN) Courses: a Case Analysis of One University
projects.description: Colleges and universities offer various forms of Writing Intensive (WIN) courses across the curriculum to better prepare learners for their future careers. The effectiveness of WIN courses in STEM fields is important to enhance the learners’ skills and representations of diversity in professions. Therefore, it is important to monitor the challenges and successes of such courses. This research paper is intended to enhance refining WIN programs in STEM fields, making more informed evidence-based decisions in creating and implementing such programs, and informing program development that can leverage the quality of STEM education.
